Maya Patel: Postmortem posted: https://redwood.infra/postmortems/2026-03-routing. Recurring p95 spikes on routing layer. I added follow-ups in the doc; please claim owners.
Kevin Zhou: I'll take routing change (item A). ETA 2w. Will run pinned-load staging canary.
Diego Ramos: I'll take KVCACHE tuning + regression harness (item B). ETA 1w for canary.
Evelyn Park: I'll update dashboards and alerts (item C). What SLA numbers should I display?
Maya Patel: SLA after incident: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 350ms for text-gen. Throughput targets unchanged. Error-budget rule: freeze noncritical deploys if monthly burn >50%. Put that on the dashboard and runbook.
Kevin Zhou: Rollout plan includes fallback to smaller model if latency >400ms for 20s. Will open PR.
Diego Ramos: For KVCACHE TTL, do we prefer per-tenant prefixes for big customers?
Maya Patel: Yes, per-tenant prefixing preferred. Add perf numbers to design doc.
Evelyn Park: Planned alert tweak:
```
alert: RoutingP95High
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(route_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 0.12
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/routing-p95
```
I'll add burn-rate panel and a 'deploy freeze active' indicator.
SRE Oncall Bot: Incident #2026-03-12 created, runbook linked.
Kevin Zhou: Canary stat: pinned-load p95 improved ~18% with routing tweak. Graphs in PR.
Evelyn Park: Dashboard PR incoming, cc @Maya Patel for SLA wording.
Maya Patel: Diego schedule canary demo next Thu. Evelyn ship dashboard+alert by EOD Fri to monitor over weekend. Add a 2-week post-deploy verification step in the postmortem.
Diego Ramos: Demo scheduled Thu 10:00 PT.
Evelyn Park: Target EOD Fri; will post link when live.
Maya Patel: Final: follow-up check 2 weeks after fixes go live to verify regression and close items.
Kevin Zhou: Ack, will post rollout summary. :thumbsup: 
SRE Oncall Bot: Follow-up meeting added (2026-03-26 17:00 UTC).
